BackstoryDef.title: bower born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in the sealed bower of [PAWN_possessive] house, tutored by servants who never once met [PAWN_possessive] eyes. [PAWN_pronoun] could read a tide-chart before [PAWN_pronoun] could walk, and had never seen an open sky.

BackstoryDef.title: veiled scion
BackstoryDef.description: The third eye opened on [PAWN_nameDef] years before the house thought [PAWN_objective] ready. [PAWN_pronoun] spent the rest of childhood behind a weighted blindfold, learning to endure what [PAWN_pronoun] could not stop seeing.

BackstoryDef.title: house ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was handed to a rival house as a living seal on a pact, and raised in their halls as an honoured hostage. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which smiles meant a knife long before [PAWN_pronoun] learned the warp tides.

BackstoryDef.title: void cradled
BackstoryDef.description: Born aboard a vessel already underway, [PAWN_nameDef] took [PAWN_possessive] first breath of recycled air. The empyrean through the oculus came before [PAWN_possessive] mother's face, and solid ground came years after both.

BackstoryDef.title: pale scion
BackstoryDef.description: Sickly even by the standards of [PAWN_possessive] line, [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood in the house medicae being measured. [PAWN_pronoun] learned [PAWN_possessive] own anatomy from physicians arguing over how long [PAWN_pronoun] would last.

BackstoryDef.title: ship's navigator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served decades in the bower of a single vessel, guiding her by a light the crew below only prayed to. [PAWN_pronoun] knows that hull better than any face aboard it.

BackstoryDef.title: charter-sworn
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] signed onto a rogue trader's warrant and spent [PAWN_possessive] adulthood past the edge of the charted lanes, plotting courses no house archive had a name for. The pay was obscene. The odds were worse.

BackstoryDef.title: fleet navigator
BackstoryDef.description: Seconded to a battlefleet, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to plot a translation with the gun decks hammering underfoot. Admirals shouted at [PAWN_objective] like any other officer, which no house bower had prepared [PAWN_objective] for.

BackstoryDef.title: warp cartographer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] charted the shifting tides for a living, illuminating route-maps that sold for more than the ships which used them. A good chart is a house's true wealth, and [PAWN_pronoun] drew [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: black ship navigator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] steered the psyker tithe to Terra, hold after hold of it, year after year. The cargo was audible for the whole passage. [PAWN_pronoun] does not discuss the work.
